settings.title: Training settings
settings.description: What the training department changes without a release: the rules of a request, the times of the dates, the positions trained on.

fields.minimumHours: Minimum hours to ask for a training
fields.cooldownDays: Days to wait after a training
fields.noShowCooldownDays: Days to wait after a no-show
fields.maxResponseDays: Days to choose a date before the training closes
fields.responseReminderDays: Days without a chosen date before the trainer is alerted
fields.conflictPolicy: When a proposed date meets the calendar
fields.reminderLeadHours: Hours before a session the reminder is sent

hints.minimumHours: Connection hours as a controller for an ATC rating, as a pilot for a pilot rating. A member with fewer cannot ask for that rating. No row: no threshold.
hints.maxResponseDays: Empty: a training never closes by itself, and the staff closes it by hand.
hints.conflictKinds: A proposed date that falls on an entry of one of these kinds is handled as the setting above says.
hints.hiddenPositions: The trainees are offered every position of the division a rating is trained on, the military ones included, except these.
hints.theoryExamUrl: Shown with the question on the theory exam, and to whoever approves a request.

conflictPolicy.Warn: Warn, and let the trainer confirm

errors.ratingNotTrained: This rating has no practical training.
errors.ratingTwice: This rating has more than one row.
errors.positionUnknown: The division no longer trains on this position: take it out of the list.
errors.calendarKindUnknown: One of these is not a kind of the calendar.
